public_version_metadata.details: The public semantic release version is distinct from the internal scientific, manuscript, and audit-package provenance identifiers.

manuscript_link.details: The current branch contains only the V9.3 active manuscript lock. V9.1 and earlier locks are historical Git records, not current release files.

dataset_citation_closure.details: All dataset keys required by DATASET_CITATION_MAP.csv are represented in the active manuscript's 26-key citation set.

packaging_checks.details: Portable text is UTF-8 without BOM and LF-only; manifests use POSIX paths; root and Figure 1 manifests/checksums were regenerated; no nested archive, symlink, sensitive filename, cache directory, or GitHub-size file issue was found. Root .git metadata is ignored when the tools run in a normal checkout, while nested .git directories remain forbidden.

security_scan.details: The public tree contains no machine path, nested .git directory, environment/credential file, private-key marker, or recognized high-confidence token pattern.

git_normalization_check.details: A fresh temporary Git repository with core.autocrlf=false and core.eol=lf passed git diff --cached --check; the temporary repository was removed afterward.

release_validator.details: The validator passed v1.2.0 package metadata, source locks, 210-cell score coverage, citation maps, cohort provenance, frozen-BP redistribution boundaries, Path A rebuild, Figure 1 rebuild, Table II reconstruction, manuscript-link alignment, and public-license/readiness guards.

claim_alignment.details: The active claim contract remains bounded to descriptive ranks, Holm-corrected significance results, and exploratory partition-structure associations. No algorithm, score, parameter, figure value, table value, or scientific conclusion changed.

license_scope_checks.details: The root MIT license covers project-authored material; the six UCI-derived Iris/Mushroom frozen-BP files remain separately attributed under CC BY 4.0.

third_party_license_checks.details: No third-party author repository, MATLAB binary/P-code/MEX component, or dependency wheel/source is vendored.

python_tests.details: The skipped classic-baseline regression requires the frozen optional pymetis dependency and is not counted as a pass. One non-fatal joblib warning reported unavailable physical-core detection and used logical cores instead.

limitations: The repository does not redistribute the manuscript ZIP or verification PDF; it records their SHA-256 identities only.
A full ten-dataset Path B rerun still requires locally supplied legal inputs and excluded third-party environments.
The public YACHT adapter still requires the separately supplied audited compatibility helper.
